main: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied transparent Spine character sprite sheet (not a new character concept). Preserve the same 13 separated parts in exactly the same cells, orientations, silhouettes and overall design. Dark fairytale hand-painted gray-brown/taupe spider with muted plum abdomen stripes and garnet red glass eyes. Keep the large abdomen and circular featureless head at the top visually unchanged. Repair the small parts: the three small eyes and both large open eyes should be COMPLETE rounded garnet-red eyes with tiny ivory highlights, thin dark rims, no flat cutoffs. The alternate closed-eye expressions retain their existing forms but use the SAME dark taupe-gray fur color as the lower-front portion of the circular head, not bright pink patches. Two plain eyelid pieces on the bottom row should match that head color seamlessly, with very subtle fine fur strokes, NO black border or highlight around their joining edges. Both ivory mouth mandibles must have continuous painted surface right to the silhouette, with gentle shading and thin outlines, no black backing wedge or drop shadow. Preserve all 13 parts, including the tiny group of 3 eyes as a single part. Do not add eyes onto the blank head. Keep all empty areas truly transparent. No text, labels, background, drop shadows, glow, extra limbs, new symbols, or assembled spider. Ensure generous transparent gaps between parts. Output square transparent sprite sheet.
legs: Use case: precise-object-edit. This transparent Spine sprite sheet contains exactly twelve separate spider leg segments in a four column by three row layout. Keep every piece in its current cell, at precisely the same angle, silhouette, length and proportions; do not assemble them. Retain the dark taupe-gray short fur, muted plum tones and ivory bands, hand-painted dark fairy tale style. Improve continuity at the joints: remove the thick black outlines and enclosed black rims around the rounded root end of each segment, replacing them with soft taupe fur matching the interior. Keep only a thin subtle contour along exposed sides and pointed ends. No rim lighting, no black backing shapes, no drop shadows, no extra parts. Fur detail should be soft and not scratchy. Preserve generous fully transparent space between all twelve segments, square sprite sheet.
